title: Ergast Race Result Points Scored Leaderboard
dataSources: FastF1 session data (`fastf1:session`), Ergast race results (`ergast:result`), F1 Fantasy teams (`f1fantasy:team`), race watch parties (`race:watchparty`), and F1 telemetry laps (`f1telemetry:lap`).
app: FastF1 session exports, Ergast race results, F1 Fantasy team snapshots, race watch-party logs, and F1 telemetry lap dumps forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ergast:result points=*
| stats sum(points) as total_value, avg(points) as avg_value by constructor
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks constructor values by total and average points scored across Ergast race result events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `points` values for each Ergast race result event and review total and average points scored by constructor.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total points scored.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which constructor shows the biggest points scored numbers in your Ergast race result data.
